Ben / Laura — operational answers below and I've attached the hosting diagram and the draft runbook. High level:

- EU-only processing: For Hosted customers, we offer region pinning that ensures inference instances and customer payloads are processed on EU hosts (AWS eu-west-1 / GCP europe-west1). Control plane metadata (account records, usage aggregates) are stored in our control plane; for strict EU-only contractual commitments we recommend Dedicated pool or Private deployment (VPC) which keeps both control plane and compute within customer-managed or EU-only infrastructure.

- Backups & snapshots: By default we create encrypted backups for model artifacts and checkpointing. For Hosted EU-only configured customers, backups are stored in EU regions only unless configured otherwise. Cross-region replication is off by default for accounts marked EU-only. We can provide a configuration flag that prevents any automatic cross-region snapshot replication.

- KMS / Keys: We support customer-managed keys (CMKs) in supported cloud regions (AWS KMS, GCP KMS). For Dedicated/Private, customers can use their own KMS/HSM in-region.

- Deletion & proof: Runbook attached includes: (1) delete customer object store buckets; (2) purge model caches and KV stores; (3) remove snapshots and verify object metadata deletion; (4) mark records in control plane for retention expiry. Proof-of-deletion artifacts: purge job logs, snapshot deletion records, S3 lifecycle audit entries, and a signed deletion statement. We keep a retention window for internal logs for debugging (configurable), but we can scope the retention applicable to Acme's contract.

Open items:
- Need to confirm whether Acme requires deletion proof for ephemeral inference caches (KV cache) or only persistent storage.
- For Hosted plan, confirm whether they accept 'control plane metadata in US' or require everything in EU — this changes recommendation to Dedicated/Private.

I recommend we send the attached runbook + diagram and Laura attaches the attestation paragraph with conditional language for control plane residency.

Naomi
Director, Infrastructure
Redwood Inference
